authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11567 vārdala gives Prakrit vaddala “cloud” and Bihari/Maithili bādar, Hindi badlī/badrā “cloud/cloudiness”. The survey badar/badri cloud forms fit this documented family; the precise intra-IA transmission remains open. Joint comparison: Dang badʌɾi “cloud” matches reviewed Rana badʌɾi “cloud” (f_dtp5sdjz3kzlc). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
